messages.content: Create a freestanding elliptical halo sculpture in the vertical XY plane, centered on X=0 and Z=0. Its outer ellipse is 1.5 m wide and 2 m tall; the concentric opening is 1.24 m wide and 1.74 m tall. Make it 12 cm deep through Z, with its lowest point 30 cm above ground. Carry it on two slender vertical round supports, 64 cm apart symmetrically, rising from a separate 1.8 by 0.45 m plinth that is 18 cm high. Let the supports meet the lower rim rather than fill the opening. Keep the halo, both supports and plinth as four editable components. Leave the existing samples untouched.
